column2: This ability costs {3} less to activate if you had 200 or more cards in your starting deck.
trigger "Whenever one or more charge counters are put on ~ for the first time each turn"
Whenever you cast an artifact creature or Equipment spell, you may copy that spell. Do this only once each turn.

If you can't, exile up to one target creature. after the chosen assimilate: a performed binding for Choose+R116Assimilate (Effect::R116Assimilate is Reports::Nothing in resolve/prim/done.rs) and the reader/writer for "If you can't"
+1: Add one mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast an Aura spell this turn, create ... and "−3: ... For each Aura attached to you, attach it to an opponent of your choice."
the next artifact creature spell and the next Spacecraft spell you cast this turn have undaunted

For each opponent, ... up to one target ... from that player's graveyard: one target spec per opponent (TargetSpec divided by player, like "for each opponent, up to one target creature that player controls") with the "put there from the battlefield this turn" filter, then R116Assimilate of each

a conditional free cast of the revealed top card (CastFromZone free under "if that spell's mana value is equal to or less than <count>", a condition on the card cast), a land alternative and the "still on top of your library" condition (Condition over the card's zone and position)

Each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. Assimilate one of the creature cards revealed this way. Then each opponent puts the other cards ...: reveal-until per opponent, a Choose among the revealed creature cards, then R116Assimilate
put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. At the beginning of the next end step, put it on the bottom of your library. When you do, draw a card.

Once during each of your turns, you may cast an artifact spell from the top of your library (MayCast from Library top with once) writer, and "Spacecraft you control enter with two additional charge counters on them" (an enters-with replacement for a group of yours)
token copy "except it isn't legendary, it's an Illusion artifact in addition to its other types, and it has haste. Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step."
stations Spacecraft and crews Vehicles as though his power were tripled
chapter III "Exile the Borg assimilated with this Saga, then return it ...": a memory of what the Saga assimilated (R116Assimilate does not remember into the source's slot)

clone "except it isn't legendary and it has \"This creature's power and toughness are each equal to ...\"": a granted characteristic-defining ability in the copy exception (CopyExcept with GrantAbility of a defining Static)

You may cast any number of spells with mana value less than or equal to <count> from among those cards without paying their mana costs: RepeatEach over the exiled cards with a ManaValue filter whose amount is fixed as the ability resolves (the count may change as Officers are cast), and its writer "from among those cards"

It enters with X additional +1/+1 counters on it if it's a creature and X additional charge counters on it if it's a Spacecraft, where X is ...: conditional counters on entry by type of the moved card

draw a card for every five creature types ...: an Amount divided by a number rounded down (no Amount::Div exists) and "If you draw three or more cards this way" (an amount of the cards drawn by the resolution)
granted beam me up to graveyard cards during your main phase with cost equal to the mana cost and the self-exclusion
Faeries you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each creature type among non-Borg creatures you already control: an enters-with replacement counted by an Amount::Distinct
Copy that card X times ... You may cast the copies without paying their mana costs. Exile ~.: copies of a card in exile cast for free

mode one "Return one or two target creature and/or Spacecraft cards from your graveyard to your hand" inside a modal spell: the writers of "one or two target" and of a type-or-subtype card filter (r118_01_wordings) work on whole abilities, and a twin of the whole modal spell also words the other modes (Yuna's Decision would read wrongly), so a per-mode writer for those two pieces is missing; mode two reads
IV: Condition "all cards exiled with this Saga share a card type" (a Condition over Pred::ExiledWith(This) that the objects share one CardType, CR 700.13-like)

An optional reveal of the top card followed by a draw only if it is an artifact card and a "if you don't draw a card this way" condition on the draws of the resolution (Condition over the Draw's bound result)

A choice given to the controller of a target spell to exile it (May with who = ControllerOf(Target 0) over Exile of a spell on the stack), then "if they don't" read from that player's answer, then a free cast from hand
TriggerPattern for any random action of the controller (discard at random, random targets, random modes, coin flip, die roll) as one batch event
A cast permission for the target opponent on your ability's resolution (CastFromZone with who = Target 0 from their hand, free), "if they do" copying the spell they cast for you, else a draw

AsCopy counters equal to the same number and kinds of counters the copied permanent has (CopyCounters of every kind of the copied object, `counters: [{of: copied}]`), and a writer for "except it isn't legendary" on an artifact-or-creature copy
Trigger on casting a spell or activating a non-mana ability with {X} in its cost, with an effect that sets the announced X to 5 (a replacement of the X announcement, CR 601.2b), once each turn
If you put two or more +1/+1 counters on creatures this way (Amount of counters the resolution put, R110RemovePutThisWay-like count of PutCounters this way)

A named Equipment token with its own equip cost and a granted static ("with \"Equipped creature gets +1/+1\" and equip {2}"), Attach to the source; "Each Equipment token you control becomes a copy of target Equipment you control until end of turn" (BecomeCopy over Each)
Secret number choice of each opponent (R110SecretOpponent exists for one), the opponent with the highest number, and that opponent's free cast from among the exiled cards, then the rest to your hand
TriggerPattern for an opponent's spell or activated ability of a source with the chosen card name (CardName chosen as it enters), with the player as Triggering

ReplaceBy for "enters tapped and attacking" on an Enters replacement of creatures you control, with the condition "while you control an attacking creature", and the attack target chosen as it enters (CR 508.4)
Opponent's optional draw with "if they do" followed by casting a spell from that opponent's hand without paying its mana cost (MayCast from another player's hand, free)
Pred "that you've put a counter on this turn" (a turn log of counters put by a player, per permanent, TallyEvent CountersPut with by)
GameRule TriggerAgain for the triggered abilities of one chosen creature, lasting for as long as the source remains tapped (Duration WhileTapped)
can't be beamed up (the Beam me up keyword of pack r116-01: a restriction on returning the enchanted permanent as the Beam me up cost)
Granting a trigger to the entering creature that copies the card exiled by this ability and casts the copy free (linked exile carried into a granted ability)

A trigger on a source you control dealing damage "if at least one permanent or player was dealt exactly 2 of that damage" (a batch DealsDamage with a per-recipient amount filter), then exile the top card with play until the end of your next turn

A spell whose targets depend on whether it was kicked (target creature an opponent controls unkicked, target opponent kicked, CR 601.2c) and a CopyOf token for each creature that player controls, except it has menace
Contract counters on players and a delayed "when they lose the game, for each artifact and creature they controlled, create a token copy" (a player loss trigger with LKI of their permanents)

A conditional activated effect "If ~ is a Rogue, he becomes a Ferengi Scout with base power and toughness 3/4 and gains a quoted trigger" (Continuous SetCreatureTypes + SetPT + GrantAbility under If Matches This), and the second form granting two rules (play lands from graveyard, an additional land)

the rider "If you cast a spell this way, that artifact creature enters with a finality counter on it" on a MayCast once each turn from the graveyard (R112SpellsGain-like rider of the permission with an EntersBonus of a finality counter)

An optional replacement of a draw by a choice of land or nonland and a RevealUntil of that kind, the card to hand and the rest to the bottom at random (ReplaceWhen Draw by MayInstead with ChooseWords feeding the RevealUntil filter)
Granting an activated ability to a card in exile ("Exile a card from your hand: Create a copy of this card. You may cast the copy. Activate only during your turn and only if this card is exiled.")

That opponent as the controller of the target before control changes (a Bind of ControllerOf(Target 0) the writer words), and "If they do" after a control change to a target opponent (Performed of a Continuous SetController)
Eminence trigger from the command zone (from: Command or Battlefield) and a trigger on exactly 1 damage to you or exactly 1 life lost, with a second-resolution rider
A named legendary Aura Curse token created attached to a target player, with enchant player and a life-loss doubling replacement for the enchanted player
Amount "the number of other creatures you control with a Communicator attached to them" in a granted attack trigger, then "you may put up to X land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped"

A delayed trigger returning the creature sacrificed for the activation's cost (Ref::Paid read by a DelayedTrigger made by the resolution: the card in the graveyard the sacrificed permanent became, CR 400.7)
TriggerPattern for cards exiled from an opponent's library by a spell or ability you control (batch), with play permission until the end of your next turn and mana of any type

A static over creature spells you control and creature cards you own in every zone but the battlefield and the stack (AnyOf In zones, Stack spells), and "as long as it's not attacking or blocking" on each other creature
Per-opponent choice of a creature card in that player's graveyard put there from their library this turn (zone history of the card) onto the battlefield under your control
Optional fight of two chosen targets and a turn-long trigger on a creature that fought this way dying (a fought-this-way binding)
Sacrifice him unless you sacrifice three creatures, pay 3 life, and have target opponent draw three cards: an unless-cost whose part is an effect on a target opponent (draw as a cost part)

Exile face down of another player's top card by that player with a play permission for the player who exiled it for as long as it remains exiled, mana of any type (per-exiler permissions, R114ExiledByThem)
Assist (CR 702.132) given to the first spell cast each of your turns, and a SpellCast trigger "if another player spent mana to cast it" naming that player
Look at target opponent's hand, exile a nonland card from it; its owner may play it as long as it stays exiled at {2} more (MayCast for the owner with a cost increase linked to the exiled card)
